subject.title: fix(openai): enable prompt cache keys for Azure

question: Should OpenClaw make `prompt_cache_key` an automatic default for existing dedicated Azure OpenAI and identified OpenAI-family Azure AI Foundry Chat Completions configurations?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly scoped and preserves an explicit opt-out, but it intentionally changes outgoing request fields for already configured provider routes; that compatibility policy requires maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Accept the targeted Azure default
options.body: Merge the resolver-based default with the explicit false override and focused Azure/Foundry regression coverage retained.

options.title: Keep Azure opt-in only
options.body: Require operators to continue setting `compat.supportsPromptCacheKey: true` until endpoint policy is confirmed more broadly.

recommendation.title: Accept the targeted Azure default
recommendation.body: Merge the resolver-based default with the explicit false override and focused Azure/Foundry regression coverage retained.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged compatibility override defines the contract this PR extends, making this the closest feature-history routing candidate.
